common.gov_site: Official website of the Italian Public Administration
disco.meta_description: Choose the digital identity system to access the services.
disco.title: Sign in to the reserved area
disco.lead: Choose the digital identity system you want to sign in with.
disco.legal_entity.note_html: Access on behalf of a business. Use SPID with a professional-use identity of the legal entity. CIE and eIDAS are not available for this type of access.
disco.spid.description_html: SPID, the Public Digital Identity System, lets you use a single digital identity to access the online services of the Italian Public Administration and of accredited private organisations. If you already have a digital identity, sign in with your identity provider's credentials. If you don't have one yet, request it from one of the identity providers.
disco.spid.idp_subtitle: Sign in with the SPID credentials you already have.
disco.spid.no_providers: No provider is available at the moment.
disco.spid.agid_logo_alt: SPID logo - AGID - Agency for Digital Italy
disco.cie.description_html: The Carta d'Identità Elettronica (CIE, Italian electronic identity card) is the personal document that certifies a citizen's identity. It has a microchip and, besides proving your identity, gives access to the digital services of the Public Administration.
disco.eidas.description: European Union citizens can access online services with their own national digital identity through the Italian eIDAS node.
